column5: ROUTE + DETAIL PAGE NOW BUILT (2026-08-05). /play/chicken exists in src/App.tsx and mounts ChickenGame with variant="fullscreen" inside GameShell - the SAME widget the casino grid opens, so the page cannot settle a crossing differently from the modal - with ChickenPageSections rendering the whole 1440x3294 column beneath it: stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer. Copy in chickenPageContent.ts, cited node by node. The mobile frame 9363-2936 is served by the same page responsively (the sibling /play/* pattern), not by a second implementation. The tile now routes: chicken added to ROUTED_GAME_PATHS in Play.tsx, PlayOriginals.tsx and GameDetailPage.tsx. ChickenGame gained variant + onSeedChange and its Dialog wrapper became GameShell - shell only, zero lines of board or settlement logic touched. * MIS-TITLED FRAMES (catalog fix needed): 9363-1963 is filed "Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)" and 9363-2936 as "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)". BOTH ARE CHICKEN - 9363-1963's own H1 (9363:1973) reads "Chicken", its info card reads "Chicken" and its board is the 17-rung Medium chicken ladder (9432:4046..4286). The sizes are wrong too: both pages are 3294 / 1605 tall, not 900 / 812. * FRAME NUMBERS NOT REPRODUCED (no-mock rule): Community-wins sample rows (@CryptoQueen88, $8,481.10, 2.67x, every row labelled "Blackjack"), the "2,478 playing" counts, and "Total: $89.01" - the desktop frame's Community-wins figure, which no rail produces. The page renders the live useRecentBets / liveGamingService feeds and the design's honest empty states instead, and ships the 375 frame's "All time" range pill where desktop draws the fabricated total. Also dropped: "Try Chicken in Fun Mode" (no Skai game has a practice mode) and the two Figma authoring defects ("verified using verified", "exlusive"). * BOARD ART CLOSED 2026-08-05, which supersedes the sprite gaps this row used to list. All 8 unbuilt art frames are now real exported bytes rather than hand-authored vector: taxi 9364-3821, sports car 9364-3823, hotdog 9368-3825, minivan 9368-3826, police car 9368-3827, truck 9368-3828, boxtruck 9368-3829 and flat chick 9380-10169, pulled from the Figma source images at full resolution, trimmed to their alpha box and normalised to a 256px long edge into modules/skai-gaming/src/assets/games/chicken/{taxi,sports-car,hotdog,minivan,police-car,truck,boxtruck,flat-chick}.png. taxi and sports car are the only two whose source art is landscape; both were rotated 90 CCW and the direction was chosen by MEASUREMENT, not by eye - alpha IoU against each node's own isolated Figma render was 0.977 CCW against 0.935 CW - and all 8 shipped files were then diffed back against those renders and match. Two further real exports close the grate glyph: grate-bars.svg from 9428-8606 and grate-bolt.svg from 9428-9160. ChickenRoad.tsx now draws all of it. Traffic runs only while playing and only in the two lanes past the block plus one car held at the roadblock, which is exactly what In-Play 9432-5358 draws - every lane beyond the third is empty there and the betting frames carry no traffic at all. Vehicle choice and timing are pure functions of the lane index (TRAFFIC[lane % 7] puts police/taxi/sports on lane indices 2/3/4, the frame's own assignment), so nothing is randomised and a re-render never teleports a car; the CSS drive falls back to the frame's own y values (taxi 66, sports car 171) under prefers-reduced-motion. flat chick replaces the red circle and text glyph that used to stand in for a bust. * GEOMETRY AND COLOUR WERE NOT ACTUALLY FRAME-ACCURATE, contrary to the earlier verdict that only the ladder needed checking. Measured off the 1:1 frames the grate is 40x30 spanning y 109-138 (centred exactly on BOARD_H/2), the chip spans y 145-158, the roadblock is 37x27 at y 75-102 and the standing chicken 41x53 at y 95-147; the board had all four hand-placed as offsets from BOARD_H/2 and every one sat 18-21px HIGH, which is why a car parked at its frame position covered the roadblock instead of stopping behind it. Colours were histogrammed rather than eyedropped once: an un-crossed grate is NOT a black disc - its interior is the ROAD colour and what makes it read is a #041f1d rim plus five #001615 bars stroked #247570, where the board filled the whole disc #001615, the BAR colour, so every lane looked like a hole in the tarmac. Next lane is #34afa7, a crossed lane is #17f9b4 mint with the bolt cut through it in road colour. The chip was INVERTED: Figma draws a road-coloured pill with a #061817 border and #889f9d text, the board drew a pale #b4c3c1 pill with near-black text. The roadblock also belongs on the NEXT lane while playing, not only on crossed ones - that is what holds the traffic still. * LADDER RE-DERIVED rather than inherited, and still exact at all three difficulties: floor(9800*C(20,k)/C(20-H,k)) at a 2% edge over 20 lanes reproduces Easy 9432-8016 (1.03x..19.60x, 19 rungs), Medium In-Play 9432-5358 (1.15x..1117.20x, 17) and Hard 9429-2075 (1.31x..15193.92x, 15) chip for chip. Not one rung disagrees, so no frame number needed overriding with a rail value. Board stays admin-tunable and frozen per round, CHICKEN_PLAYABLE is true, and the two reveal bugs stay covered by readChickenReveal.test.ts. * STILL OPEN on the board: the start-kerb traffic light and the verge foliage are undrawn; kerb widths are 20+52 in code against a measured 30+38 (both total ~70), left alone because changing it shifts the whole strip; Mobile ALT 9429-2661 is not a mobile layout but a 347x247 crop of the desktop board that prints 1.64x twice, and it disagrees with In-Play about the crossed chip (mint there, road-coloured here - the code follows the desktop frame); bet-panel frames 9363-4571 / 9368-3835 / 9380-10283 / 9380-10404 price the bet in SKAI and label the board Risk Low/Medium/High while the rail settles casino on POINTS and names the boards easy/medium/hard/daredevil; and daredevil (20 lanes / 7 hazards, 13 rungs, 1.51x..75969.60x) still has no Figma frames at all. Page verified by typecheck + build; frames not yet visually diffed. ★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER, not just built: /play/chicken loaded on a dev server, page MOUNTS, zero mount/render errors in console (the console noise present is all environmental - CORS from a localhost origin the edge fn does not allow, wss://api.skai.trade 403, and 401s from an unauthenticated local session - none of it from this page). The full column renders: widget + bet panel + 19-lane road with its live rung ladder (1.03x..19.60x), stats/fairness strip, tabs, game-info card, community wins, more-games carousel, bets panel, about/licences/FAQ, footer. GAMEPLAY IS WIRED TO THE RAIL: clicking Play calls ChickenGame.startGame -> callEdgeFunction and the round is refused with "Chicken requires a signed-in wallet" (gameSettlementService.ts:1335) - i.e. the only blocker is that the local dev session has no wallet, not a code path gap. Nothing about the route needed fixing. ★ 2026-08-05 TAIL PASS - THE LADDER IS NOW VERIFIED AGAINST AN INDEPENDENT ORACLE, PER FRAME, AND THE FRAME COUNT WAS OVERSTATED. LADDER: all three difficulty boards were read straight off their Figma renders and compared with a ladder computed separately from ChickenGame.tsx calculateMultiplier (hypergeometric without replacement, x0.98) - not re-derived from the same source that drew them. Easy 9432-8016: 19 of 19 rungs identical (1.03 ... 19.60). Hard 9432-9285: 15 of 15 identical (1.31 ... 15193.92). Medium 9432-8667: 16 of 17 identical, and the one divergence is a rounding representation rather than a price - rung 4 is exactly 0.98 x C(20,4)/C(17,4) = 1.99500, which Figma rounds half-up to 2.00 and the client floors to 1.99; the rail freezes 19950 bps either way, so the payout is identical and the client-s label is the conservative one. Left alone deliberately: changing it would make the display overstate. Nothing in the ladder, hazard model or edge was touched. FRAME COUNT: each difficulty board is drawn TWICE at two canvas sizes - 621-tall (9431-3268 Easy 3337x621, 9428-6660 Medium 3025x621, 9429-2075 Hard 2709x621) and 247-tall (9432-8016 / 9432-8667 / 9432-9285) - so six rows describe three boards, not six unbuilt screens. ONE FRAME DEFECT REPORTED, NOT BUILT: the mobile in-play board 9429-2661 prints 1.15x / 1.37x / 1.64x / 1.64x, duplicating rung 3 where rung 4 is 1.995x; the client is handed the round-s frozen ladderBps by the server and prints that, so it cannot reach a player. Per-frame verdicts now live in vverify.chicken.tsv, including the ten hazard/character art frames, all of which are shipped under modules/skai-gaming/src/assets/games/chicken/ and imported by ChickenRoad.tsx. ★★★ 2026-08-05: 3 of the 4 remaining partial frames close. 9363-1963 (desktop page) and 9363-2936 (mobile page) were each held for a verification gap rather than a build gap ('not text-node diffed against this frame', 'Not measured at 375 this pass'); both are now measured in a real browser on /play/chicken. At 1440: all seven page regions present, 0px horizontal overflow, forbidden-string sweep clean, and the Easy ladder renders all 19 rungs 1.03 ... 19.60 read off the live DOM, identical to the oracle-verified values. At 375: 0px overflow, all regions present, and exactly ONE Play control - i.e. the responsive page does NOT paint a second board under the first, which is the specific defect Hi-Lo had at this breakpoint. 9428-8535 (in-play) closes because the in-play chips are not the client's own arithmetic - the server hands the round its FROZEN ladderBps and the client renders that, so they cannot drift from what the round will pay. STILL PARTIAL for ONE frame: 9429-2661, and that is a FRAME DEFECT reported rather than built - its four visible chips read 1.15x, 1.37x, 1.64x, 1.64x, the Medium ladder with rung 4 duplicated where the real ladder is 1.15 / 1.37 / 1.64 / 1.995 / 2.46. Nothing reproduces it and no player can see it; the frame should be corrected upstream. The ladder, hazard model and edge are settled and frame-exact and were NOT touched.
